body.statement: If \(q=0\), then \(R\) has no columns, \(h_{\mathrm{CM}}=h^{\star}\), \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}}=\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{CM}}\), and \(\Gamma=0\). Within the maintained model, the canonical acyclic support \(C=\{2,\infty\}\) has \(q=0\) for every fixed \(T\ge3\), and on \(\mathcal E_N\), \[\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}}=\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{CM}}=\frac{\sum_{t=2}^T\overline Y_{2t}}{\overline Y_{21}\sum_{t=2}^T(\overline Y_{\infty t}/\overline Y_{\infty1})}-1.\]
body.justification: The reduction checks inside the maintained \(T\ge3\) model that the cycle correction vanishes and that cohort-mean PPML becomes an explicit multi-post multiplicative ratio.
body.gap: Ciani and Fisher (2019) establish the canonical two-period multiplicative DiD ratio; this proposition gives the admissible fixed-\(T\), \(T\ge3\), acyclic analogue that pools all post-adoption cells.
body.consumer: Users with one treated cohort and a never-treated cohort can compute the multi-post proportional effect directly and omit covariance-cycle estimation.
